title: Split chunks into lines
summary: Turn arbitrary text chunks into complete lines, keeping partial lines between chunks the way a stream transform must.
prompt:
Finish `createLineSplitter()`. It returns an object with:
- `push(chunk)`: takes the next chunk of text and returns the **complete** lines it finished, without their line endings;
- `end()`: returns the final partial line as a one-item array, or `[]` if nothing is left.

Lines end with `\n` or `\r\n`. A chunk may end in the middle of a line or between `\r` and `\n`. Empty lines in the middle of the text are kept as `''`.
hints: Keep a `tail` string. Append each chunk to it, split on `\n`, and keep the last piece as the new tail.
Strip one trailing `\r` from each complete line.
In `end()`, also strip a trailing `\r` and clear the tail.
